What are the common symptoms of high blood pressure?

High blood pressure (hypertension) often has no symptoms ('silent killer'). When severe, symptoms can include headaches, shortness of breath, dizziness, and nosebleeds. Regular blood pressure screening is essential.

How should acute fever be managed at home?

Stay hydrated, rest, and use over-the-counter antipyretics such as paracetamol or ibuprofen following recommended dosages. Seek emergency care if the temperature exceeds 103°F (39.4°C) or lasts over 3 days.

Can I take paracetamol with antibiotics?
In most cases, paracetamol can safely be taken alongside common antibiotics like amoxicillin to reduce pain and fever. Always check with your pharmacist for specific drug interactions.
